name: Special Meeting and Adjournment Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: June 1, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting and Adjournment of Regular Meeting
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The regularly scheduled City Council Meeting on Tuesday, June 9, 2026, has been adjourned. In its stead, the City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Tuesday, June 9, 2026, during the following times.
The Council will convene at 9:00 a.m. in open session to hear the following items:
Non-agenda Public Comment
Fiscal Year 2026 Third Quarter Budget Monitoring Report
Fiscal Year 2026 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Year-End Budget Monitoring Report and CIP Budget Revisions.
FY 2025 Annual Reporting on Development Impact Fees and Other City Planning Managed Funds, along with Capital Improvement Program Allocations.
Allocation of Fiscal Year 2027 Parking Meter Zone Revenue for Transportation Infrastructure Improvements.
The Council will then recess and reconvene at 1:00 p.m. to hear the following:
Approval of the City’s FY 2027 Budget.
Proposed Fiscal Year 2027 City of San Diego Affordable Housing Fund Annual Plan.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
